summary: Exhaustive, 100% forensic architectural overhaul of the Sidekick autonomous agent extension. Solves all 10 verified failure points: fixes fatal ReferenceError cleanId is not defined that blocked step 1; replaces crude SVG cursor with pixel-perfect OS-standard multi-state cursor (0,0 vector hotspot, physical press-down, sub-pixel centroid targeting); eliminates false occlusion and infinite idle loops via 3-point crosshair ancestor containment; introduces autonomous child tab lineage tracking (chrome.tabs.onCreated/onUpdated); ends Gemini amnesia with action-outcome history journal; activates dormant state-diff verification and 4-tier adaptive escalation; eliminates 3.5s proxy timeout; fixes iframe coordinate double-translation; adds System Doctor PING/PONG handshake; and untangles Frankenstein spaghetti code into a modular, clean backend architecture.
